headline: GCI Buys Orbit, Not Iron / Wailand's build-or-buy call

eval_history.note: full-width cloud strata read as posterized banding; starfield too dense and close to the legacy template; broken ground line invisible; lower third dead acreage
sky fixed, but foreground became a near-black slab with visible diagonal hatch stripes

found two real bugs: .point() on an RGBA layer scaled RGB as well as alpha (darkening toward black), and Canvas.composite(layer, mask) ignores layer alpha so transparent pixels pasted as solid black. Foreground rebuilt as a dusk-lit snow plain
ruled drift stripes replaced with scattered sastrugi; route trench softened from a black snake to a graded shadow; wordmark knocked out of a chip for legibility on the lit plain
